_comment: Office contact details, copied by hand from each institution's own contact page in the crawl (data/crawl/db/), with the page and the date it was collected. Only what the page states plainly is here: a blank or placeholder field on the page is left out, and a number that belongs to a branch rather than the head office is not used. Not reviewed by a content steward, and shown that way. Shown on a source card when the cited page is on the same website (lib/kb/contacts.ts). Re-check against the source page when the crawl is refreshed.
